port/game/common/mods.cpp calls std::chrono::steady_clock::now() without including <chrono>. With libc++ on Windows (llvm-mingw, clang 23) no other header brings it in, so openrac_mods does not build there:

One line: #include <chrono> beside the other standard headers.
Verified
